sources.snippet: Kadabra/Qwen3.5-4b-gas-CPT is a 4.5 billion parameter language model developed by Kadabra, fine-tuned from unsloth/Qwen3.5-4B. This model was trained using Unsloth and Huggingface's TRL library, achieving 2x faster training speeds. It is designed for general language tasks, leveraging its efficient training methodology to provide a capable and optimized solution.
